brief_markdown:
# Decision Brief: what to teach first


## Recommendation

Run 5 courses for 263 seats at ₹3.53 lakh of a ₹4.00 lakh budget, using 188 trainer-hours of 200.

The plan is proven optimal for the stated evidence and cost assumptions.

- SAS Programming on SAS Viya for Learners: 60 seats, ₹0.45 lakh, 30 trainer-hours

- Applied Statistics & Probability: 60 seats, ₹0.78 lakh, 40 trainer-hours

- Data Storytelling with Tableau: 58 seats, ₹0.62 lakh, 30 trainer-hours

- Machine Learning Foundations: 50 seats, ₹0.97 lakh, 48 trainer-hours

- Python & SQL for Analytics: 35 seats, ₹0.70 lakh, 40 trainer-hours


## Expected effect on skill gaps

- Coding: 100% of the gap closed (77 of 77 learners)

- Maths & stats: 100% of the gap closed (82 of 82 learners)

- Dashboards & storytelling: 100% of the gap closed (58 of 58 learners)

- AI & ML: 70% of the gap closed (50 of 71 learners)

- Big data: 0% of the gap closed (0 of 65 learners)


## Why these courses

- Applied Statistics & Probability: removing it loses 35.6% of total impact. It mainly serves Maths & stats, which is in 15.9% of data-role postings, has a market pay odds ratio of 1.56 and a junior salary-hike odds ratio of 3.01.

- Python & SQL for Analytics: removing it loses 20.7% of total impact. It mainly serves Coding, which is in 40.7% of data-role postings, has a market pay odds ratio of 1.50 and a junior salary-hike odds ratio of 1.67.

- Machine Learning Foundations: removing it loses 10.6% of total impact. It mainly serves AI & ML, which is in 16.0% of data-role postings, has a market pay odds ratio of 1.44 and a junior salary-hike odds ratio of 2.00.

- SAS Programming on SAS Viya for Learners: removing it loses 8.6% of total impact. It mainly serves Coding, which is in 40.7% of data-role postings, has a market pay odds ratio of 1.50 and a junior salary-hike odds ratio of 1.67.

- Data Storytelling with Tableau: removing it loses 1.1% of total impact. It mainly serves Dashboards & storytelling, which is in 11.9% of data-role postings, has a market pay odds ratio of 1.14 and a junior salary-hike odds ratio of 2.72.


## Constraints and next steps

The next course needs more budget AND more trainer-hours together.

Adding ₹1.50 lakh alone changes impact by 0; adding 40 trainer-hours alone by 0; both together by 2375.


## Courses not chosen

- Deep Learning & NLP: forcing it in changes impact by -3000.19 (-12.8%); the budget it uses closes more demand-weighted gap elsewhere

- Big-Data Stack: Hadoop, Spark, Hive (taught as a bundle): forcing it in changes impact by -1333.11 (-5.7%); the budget it uses closes more demand-weighted gap elsewhere

- Dashboards & Storytelling with Power BI: forcing it in changes impact by -251.67 (-1.1%); the budget it uses closes more demand-weighted gap elsewhere

- Integrated Analytics Bootcamp (capstone): forcing it in changes impact by -4830.82 (-20.7%); the budget it uses closes more demand-weighted gap elsewhere


## Caveats

Market and outcome evidence are associations from SAS sample data, not causal effects. Course costs, seats, trainer-hours and coverage are documented assumptions; change them in the catalogue and re-run.
